svg.title: Reconstruction of three-panel PanoVQA, VLM/PLM comparison, and performance chart figure
svg.desc: Base frames: left pipeline panel, middle conversation comparison panel, right plot frame, and legend frame. Left panel inventory: title, three annotation-format headers with small class icons, black flow arrows, ChatGPT knot icon, filtering-and-human-check box with four visual labels, system prompt/instruction/rules box, VQA generation title, three scenario boxes, three panoramic image strips, QA star and score. Middle panel inventory: round ellipsis bubble, question banner, multi-view scene strip, red cross with red VLM speech bubble, yellow thumbs-up with green PLM speech bubble, two small modality icons at right. Right panel inventory: axes, grid, y-axis label, x-axis labels, blue PLM line, multiple dashed VLM lines, yellow star marker near final average, and legend. Symmetry/equipartition basis: left panel is a pipeline with horizontally equipartitioned top and bottom scenario blocks and central vertical flow; middle panel is vertically partitioned into prompt/images/responses; chart uses Cartesian alignment and legend-column alignment.
